assumptions: Planning simulation, not flood prediction or emergency navigation.
Population is assumed already at each assembly road node; travel from homes is excluded.
Candidate sites and capacities are assumptions, not official shelters.
All vehicle travel uses an assumed 20 km/h, no traffic or vehicle-capacity model.
Allocation may split groups; families are not preserved.
Bridge and tunnel deck heights are unknown; they stay usable unless explicitly closed or terrain coverage is missing.
HAND is a relative terrain scenario, not a gauge reading.
Unknown terrain is excluded conservatively. A small buffered catchment is not the upstream basin.
